rule_outs: Dwelling 5 m from the best section
summary: Very steep kerb with houses right at the kerb edge.

drivers.seclusion: Row of houses fronts directly on this kerb; nearest dwelling 5 m away at 65 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars do park along the kerb, so room exists, but the grade is over 12% for most of it.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; a busier road at the lower end.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked along this kerb, but outside private houses, so a van would be noticed.

flags: Steep: about 14% average, up to 22% locally
sun_shade: Mixed street trees; house shade from the west in the afternoon.
